schema:name: Regulators
schema:description:
This group includes national and local authorities responsible for health policy, sector oversight, and the legal framework for data governance. They act as the stewards of the digital health ecosystem and ensure compliance with public health mandates.

The purpose is to establish a trustworthy health data ecosystem with strong governance and regulatory oversight. This ensures that the system is equitable, secure, and serves the long-term health goals of the nation.

Example: A Ministry of Health setting national data privacy regulations and auditing compliance across the PHR network.
